question: Should this PR's redacted pre-fix production logs plus positive/negative predicate tests be accepted as sufficient proof for the non-inducible xAI stale encrypted_content rotation path, or should merge wait for an organic after-fix xAI/Grok capture?

options.title: Accept Proof Exception
